title: Java OOP & SOLID
intro: Java OOP interview questions are the single most common opener in any backend interview, from junior to staff. This page is dedicated to object-oriented design in Java — the four pillars (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction), access modifiers, abstract classes vs interfaces, composition vs inheritance, and the SOLID principles applied to real Java code. Expect questions that test conceptual depth ("explain Liskov substitution with an example") as well as design judgement ("would you use an abstract class or an interface here, and why?"). Every answer comes with a short code snippet, the trade-off the interviewer is listening for, and the follow-up they are likely to ask next.
